note_en: 医护人员专业又温和，让她渐渐放松下来 uses 让 as a causative: "(the staff being kind) made her gradually relax." English often just says "she relaxed," but Chinese likes to keep the cause as the subject and introduce the person affected with 让. Also note 放松下来: 下来 after a verb shows settling into a calmer state, like English "calm down" or "settle down."
